cases.title: POST /rooms as player-a with maxPlayers=2, mode=duel, ranked=false returns HTTP 201
preconditions: The test runs on a fresh framework fixture and creates no shared room, so no state carries over from other tests.
The request is submitted as player-a against the fixed POST /rooms interface with JSON body {maxPlayers,mode,ranked}.
steps: On the fresh framework fixture, submit POST /rooms as player-a with JSON body {"maxPlayers": 2, "mode": "duel", "ranked": false}.
Observe the HTTP status code returned for the request.
cases.expected: The system responds to the POST /rooms request submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=2, mode=duel, and ranked=false on a fresh framework fixture with HTTP status 201.
assertions: The HTTP response status code is exactly 201.

cases.title: Create room as player-a with maxPlayers=9, mode=duel, ranked=false on a fresh fixture and assert HTTP 400
preconditions: Each test uses a fresh framework fixture and creates no shared room, so no state carries over from any other test.
The room creation interface is exercised exactly as declared: POST /rooms submitted as player-a with a JSON body containing maxPlayers, mode, and ranked.
steps: Prepare a fresh framework fixture and ensure no room is shared with any other test.
Submit POST /rooms as player-a with JSON body {"maxPlayers":9,"mode":"duel","ranked":false}, keeping mode fixed to duel and ranked fixed to false.
Observe the HTTP status code of the response.
cases.expected: The POST /rooms request submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=9, mode=duel, and ranked=false on the fresh fixture receives an HTTP response with status 400.
assertions: The HTTP status code of the response to POST /rooms with maxPlayers=9 is 400.
